messages:
alex: FYI starting deploy for release/2026-03-21 at 16:00 UTC. Preflight SLO checks will run in 5m. Please standby.
deploy-bot: Triggered rollout v2026-03-21. Instances: 120 -> 140. Steps: canary (5%), ramp (50%), full. docs: https://deploys.redwood/2026-03-21
slo-bot: Preflight: fetching p95/latency, p99/5xx, error_budget left for /generate & /embed
carla: @slo-bot can you run the kv-cache tail latency check as well? saw a blip yesterday.
slo-bot: kv-cache tail p95 = 24ms (baseline 18ms), p99 = 85ms (baseline 60ms). p99 up 42% vs baseline.
ryan: Hmm. That p99 is small but correlated with embeds route from eu-west last night. Any dataset changes?
maya: No dataset changes. We did deploy a micro-change to quantize worker this morning.
alex: ok. plan: start canary at 5% but set snooze window 10m and strict SLO gating. If p99 > 2x baseline OR 5xx rate rises > 0.5% we pause roll.
carla: LGTM. Also suggest adding a short-lived route pin to previous version for embeds if errors spike.
deploy-bot: Canary started 16:05 UTC. Traffic=5% -> 6 canaries
slo-bot: Live metrics (canary): /embed p99=92ms (1.53x baseline), 5xx=0.12% (+0.02pp). monitoring window=2m
ryan: not great but within soft threshold. continue watch.
alex: monitoring… if p99 crosses 2x baseline (120ms) or 5xx >0.5% for 1m we pause. @carla @maya be ready to pin.
carla: ready. pin command: `/deploy pin v2026-03-20 --reason "canary p99 spike"`
maya: if we pin we should also rollback quantize-worker on dedicated pool — that was last change.
slo-bot: Alert (16:12): /embed p99=135ms (2.24x baseline) over 1m. 5xx=0.28%
deploy-bot: Canary paused at 16:12 UTC by SLO gate. Traffic rollback initiated for canary nodes.
alex: rolling back canary to v2026-03-20, initiating route pin for embeds.
carla: executed pin command, routing pinned to v2026-03-20 for /embed
ryan: I'll trigger rollback of quantize-worker on dedicated GPUs now.
maya: rolled back quantize-worker on pools eu-west-2, us-east-1
slo-bot: Post-rollback metrics (16:17): /embed p99=58ms, 5xx=0.03% — back to baseline.
alex: thanks team. I'll update the release notes and close the deploy. We'll schedule a follow-up to investigate quantize-worker patch.
carla: note added to release notes: canary paused & pinned due to kv-cache tail latency spike caused by quantize-worker change.
alex: closing thread. Great triage. :thumbsup:
